license_scope_review_notes: Actual model page and download modal label CC Attribution and link CC BY 4.0; packaged USDZ metadata agrees.
custom_terms_review_notes: No added use terms or separate texture rights visible; the author says one texture atlas ships with the model.
duplicate_review_notes: Named source group Metal_Door_002 is distinct from the excluded Metal_Door_007 double-leaf pair. Local fingerprint and frame ownership require inspection.

dependencies.license_evidence: source-evidence.json: sole texture packaged in the CC BY USDZ with no separately stated terms

local_dependency_review_notes: The selected USDC and packaged 1024 x 256 atlas resolve locally; USDZ metadata and source page identify CC BY 4.0, with no separately stated atlas terms.
local_duplicate_review_notes: Source geometry fingerprint ab6c85dcb24412a05dbbbd8ee9e1f5db44fabe2b81c7bf44bf16609e49fa9873 differs from the fourteen prepared doors; distinctness against pack 003/005 was also reviewed by shape alignment.
local_asset_shape_review_notes: One 1.021 x 2.125 m ornate metal leaf is modeled, with no source frame group for it. The pack single-door frame has about 0.843 m inner width, far below this leaf even after the 2% allowed fit.
local_mechanical_review_notes: The required separately collidable frame is absent and the available pack frame is not size-compatible without substantial resizing or reconstruction.
local_visual_review_notes: No normalized door passed the prior gate; RTX front/rear preparation preview was not generated or claimed.
